requirements.condition: when obtaining the secret for the version 2 Retry Integrity Tag
requirements.why_checkable: The Retry integrity secret can be compared byte-for-byte with the specified constant.

requirements.condition: when computing the version 2 Retry Integrity Tag
requirements.why_checkable: The Retry integrity key can be compared byte-for-byte with the specified constant.

requirements.condition: when computing the version 2 Retry Integrity Tag

requirements.quote: The secret is the sha256sum of "QUICv2 retry secret".
requirements.condition: when deriving the secret for the version 2 Retry Integrity Tag
requirements.required_behavior: compute the secret as the SHA-256 digest of the string "QUICv2 retry secret"
requirements.why_checkable: A derivation test can hash the specified input and compare the resulting secret.

requirements.quote:
The key and
   nonce are derived from this secret with the labels "quicv2 key" and
   "quicv2 iv", respectively.
requirements.condition: when deriving the key for the version 2 Retry Integrity Tag
requirements.required_behavior: derive the key from the specified secret with the label "quicv2 key"
requirements.why_checkable: A derivation test can supply the specified secret and verify the key produced with the required label.

requirements.quote:
The key and
   nonce are derived from this secret with the labels "quicv2 key" and
   "quicv2 iv", respectively.
requirements.condition: when deriving the nonce for the version 2 Retry Integrity Tag
requirements.required_behavior: derive the nonce from the specified secret with the label "quicv2 iv"
requirements.why_checkable: A derivation test can supply the specified secret and verify the nonce produced with the required label.
